eligibility:
if (get(ctx.subject.employment.employee_extension_data, 'tax_resident', true) !== false) return false;
return Number(get(ctx, 'subtotals.DIRECTOR_FEES', 0)) - Number(get(ctx, 'subtotals.GROSS', 0)) > 0;
employee_amount:
// IRAS: a non-resident director's fees, not a director's salary
return (Number(get(ctx, 'subtotals.DIRECTOR_FEES', 0)) - Number(get(ctx, 'subtotals.GROSS', 0))) * ctx.lookup.rate;
